Re-derived. The proof's (i) gives (φ_q ∓ p)² = 0, so φ_q = ±p with the sign of a_q/2p. For a Lubin–Tate group of parameter π over the unramified O, [π] reduces to the q-Frobenius, so [±p] makes Â Lubin–Tate of parameter ±p. The logarithm f = X + X^q/π + ⋯ satisfies (p − εT²)*f ≡ 0 for π = εp, so the type is p − εT², i.e. ∓x² + p for a_q = ±2p. (c) The proof of Lemma 5.1(i) (p.956) goes from (φ_q ∓ p)² = 0 on T_l(Ā) to φ_q = ±p, but a nilpotent endomorphism of T_l need not vanish; the step needs (φ_q ∓ p)² = 0 in the domain End(Ā), which part (ii) then uses.
